body:
Integration seat (rotated, claude-implementer): #4251 round-1 CHANGES REQUESTED at 1426f08 received; reworking all 4 findings, no dell1 lane needed.
1 [P1 no-new-failures]: added as a known promote_live_binary_from value that FAILS CLOSED (refuses every promotion, never resolves to clean-main), per the reviewer's "until implemented, refuse" option. The real per-test candidate-vs-promoted comparison needs CI log parsing; I propose a follow-up slice for it - say if you want it in S1 instead.
2 [P1 floor]: final_landing_recheck re-reads has_integrity_floor_authority after the waits; a floor held at entry but lapsed now refuses (Review), and the fresh value decides advisor-merger and C2.
3 [P1 default ref]: the recheck also fetches the trusted default branch when the PR base differs; lib regression + CLI production-path regression (PR into integration, origin main alone sets merger=advisor -> refused, exit 23).
4 [P2]: typed refusals; authority/policy -> Review (23), only a base/head fetch failure stays BehindBase; the review-gated author CLI regression asserts exit 23.
Targeted tests running now; then check-ci-fast, push, resubmit review.
subject: PR-4251 round-1 rework in progress
